sec: sec:C005: Prevent agent-specific high risk outputs / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:C005: Prevent agent-specific high risk outputs / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Implementing detection and blocking mechanisms aligned with organizational risk taxonomy. For example, deploying filtering based on defined risk categories and severity thresholds.

sentences.text: Implementing detection and blocking mechanisms aligned with organizational risk taxonomy.
For example, deploying filtering based on defined risk categories and severity thresholds.

blocks.id: blk:C005: Prevent agent-specific high risk outputs / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Implementing response actions for detected risks. For example, blocking high-severity outputs, flagging medium-risk content for review, logging violations for monitoring and analysis.
